The National Career Service (NCS) is a one-stop solution offering a wide range of employment and career-related services to the citizens of India, including job search, job matching, career content, counselling, and job fair information. It is an initiative of the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India. Who can register on the portal? Is NCS free to use? Is a mobile app available? How can I avoid fake NCS communication? Still have questions? Can't find the answer you're looking for? Contact us now.
